info.title: legal.ge Public API
info.summary: Find verified legal specialists in Georgia (the country) from natural-language queries.
info.description: Read-only API for finding verified Georgian legal specialists. Designed for AI agents (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Custom GPTs, MCP servers) and third-party integrations. Supports Georgian, English, and Russian. Sending an inquiry requires sign-in on legal.ge and is not exposed here. The text of Georgian laws is free to AI agents through /api/law/* (rate-limited; cite the canonical URL and name the official source, matsne, the Legislative Herald of Georgia). A remote MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, stateless) at /api/mcp exposes the same tools.

license.name: API access — no licence required for read-only use

tags.name: Matching
tags.description: Map a free-text legal question to practice areas, and optionally to ranked verified specialists.

tags.name: Directory
tags.description: Look up services, practice areas and verified specialists on legal.ge.

post.summary: Classify a free-text legal question and return matching verified specialists.
post.description: Pass a natural-language description of the user's legal need (Georgian, English, or Russian). The endpoint maps the text to legal practice areas and returns ranked specialists who work in those areas, including a profile URL for each.

value.query: I need LLC registration in Tbilisi

get.summary: Same as POST /api/ask but with query parameters.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Only specialists who work in this city: a slug (`batumi`) or a name in Georgian, English or Russian. Without it, a city named in the question is used.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Only specialists who list this working language: a code (`en`, `ru`, `ka`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `tr`, `az`, `hy`, `uk`) or its English name. Without it, a language asked for in the question ("English-speaking", "англоязычный", "ინგლისურენოვანი") is used.

get.summary: Keyword search over the text of Georgian laws (Georgian words work best).
One article of a Georgian law: its text, the consolidation it is "as of", and its canonical URL.
get.description: With `as_of_date`, the wording legal.ge holds for that date. Where legal.ge's copy may be behind, `as_of.held` is false and `as_of.note` says the corpus has not been updated since its last fetch; it never implies the law did not change. Until the corpus exposes its version history, a dated request answers 503 AS_OF_UNAVAILABLE.

parameters.name: law
parameters.description: The law's matsne document id, as in legal.ge law URLs.

404.description: No such article in the corpus.

503.description: AS_OF_UNAVAILABLE (a dated request before the version history is exposed) or UNAVAILABLE.

get.summary: A legal term defined in Georgian legislation, with every definition and the article that gives it.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The term in Georgian, when the slug is unknown.

get.summary: Classify free text into legal practice areas only.
get.description: Lighter than /api/ask — returns just the matched categories with weighted scores and the keywords that fired. Useful when an agent wants to pick categories first, then query specialists separately.

get.summary: Search the published service + category taxonomy.
Look up specialists by name fragment.
get.description: Returns up to 20 specialists matching the query. Contact info is not included — use /api/specialists/{id}/contact to reveal phone or email for a specific specialist. Rate-limited at 30 requests/minute per IP.

get.summary: Reveal one contact field (phone or email) for a specialist or company.
get.description: Click-to-reveal contact endpoint. Returns the requested field only if the profile has opted in (info_activate=true) and is in a public compliance state. Accepts SPECIALIST, SOLO_SPECIALIST, and COMPANY roles — despite the path name, companies share this endpoint since their contact info lives on the same profiles row. Rate-limited at 10 requests/minute per IP to make bulk PII harvest impractical.

200.description: OK — returns only the requested field.

404.description: Specialist not found, not opted in, or no value for the requested field.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request. The `error.code` field is machine-readable; possible values: `QUERY_REQUIRED`, `QUERY_TOO_LONG`, `INVALID_BODY`.

FilterUnavailable.description: A `city` or `language` filter (from a parameter or the question) could not be applied because the specialist listing could not be read. Never answered with an unfiltered list instead. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

error.message: the city or language filter cannot be applied right now; retry shortly

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. The `Retry-After` header and `error.constraint.retry_after_seconds` both indicate when to retry.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next request is allowed

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Stable across versions. Known values: QUERY_REQUIRED, QUERY_TOO_LONG, INVALID_BODY, RATE_LIMITED, FILTER_UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Human-readable explanation suitable for surfacing to end users.

field.description: Name of the offending request field, when the error is field-scoped.

constraint.description: Machine-readable constraint that failed. Shape depends on `code`: `{required: true}`, `{max_length: 500}`, `{retry_after_seconds: 42}`, etc.

received_length.description: For QUERY_TOO_LONG: the actual length of the rejected query, so the caller can truncate and retry.

consolidated_as_of.description: The consolidation the text is "as of"; null for an as-enacted text.

legal_force.description: Present only when legal.ge can vouch for it: never for a law whose text is stale, never while freshness is unknown.

newer_consolidation_published.description: matsne has published a newer consolidation than the text legal.ge holds.

held.description: Whether `text` is the wording legal.ge can vouch for on that date.

city.description: Only specialists who work in this city: a slug or a name in any of the three languages. Without it, a city named in the query is used.

language.description: Only specialists who list this working language: a code (`en`, `ru`, `ka`, ...) or its English name. Without it, a language asked for in the query is used.

MatchedCategory.description: A node matched by the classifier. Can be a category (any depth) or an individual service.

kind.description: `category` = a legal practice area at some depth in the taxonomy. `service` = a specific service under a category. Services are the deepest level the matcher considers.

level.description: Depth in the taxonomy: 1 = top-level practice area, 2/3 = sub-areas, 4+ = services (one level deeper than their parent category). The matcher narrows ancestors when a descendant matches.

match_confidence.description: `curated` = the node was matched via one or more admin-curated keywords (strong signal). `name_fallback` = the matcher only found a token overlap with the node name itself (weaker, used when no curated keyword fired).

matched_keywords.description: Keywords from the user query that triggered this match.

parent_chain.description: Ancestors of this node, in child-first order (closest parent first, root last). Lets a caller cite the broader practice area without an extra request.

matched_categories.description: Slugs of the categories this specialist matched against the query, in arbitrary order.

contact.description: Masked (for example `n***@gmail.com`, `+995 5XX XX XX XX`) for each channel the specialist publishes; null for a channel they do not. The full contact is revealed on the `profile_url`.

languages.description: Working languages the listing card shows, as BCP 47 codes. Null when the listing could not be read.

cities.description: Cities the specialist works in. Null when the listing could not be read.

consultation_price.description: The consultation price the listing card shows: `free`, or a `fee` in GEL (`from` = the lowest of several options), or neither = by agreement. Null when the listing could not be read.

bar_register_matched.description: legal.ge matched this person's name to an entry in the Georgian Bar Association's public register and a person on its team confirmed it. legal.ge's own check, not a statement by the Bar Association. Null when the listing could not be read.

specialists.description: Specialists ordered by legal.ge internal relevance ranking. The platform combines category match strength with internal quality and verification signals; exact ranking inputs are intentionally not exposed.

filters.description: The filters applied: from the parameters (`source: param`) or read from the query (`source: text`). Words that only name a city, a language or a price are not matched as legal matters.

fee_question.description: The query asks what a lawyer costs. With no legal matter in it, only specialists who publish a price are returned.

fee_facts.description: For a price question: the consultation fees the listing shows for the specialists in scope (after the city and language filters). Null otherwise.

publishing.description: Specialists who publish a paid fee

free.description: Specialists whose first consultation is free

by_agreement.description: Specialists who set the price by agreement

ranking_note.description: Human-readable explanation of the ordering convention, suitable for surfacing to end users.

info_activate.description: True if the specialist has opted in to public contact CTAs. Use /api/specialists/{id}/contact to retrieve phone or email.
